question: what are all the required courses for the music major
answer:
The catalog lists the bachelor’s major as Music BA; its other published level is Music Minor [12, 1]. Requirements depend on concentration. Full catalog: https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-MUSI [1]

Music Education: required MUSI 225, 255, 355; basics MUSI 123, 209, 210, 330, 332, 400; choose 1 technique (MUSI 206, 213, 234, 235); 8 credits group performance (MUSI 126, 227, 253, 271, 272, 273, 303, 320, 327, 364); 4 applied-music credits: 2 in MUSI 130 and 2 in 230; MUSI 450 (NJ Teacher Certification students may substitute Student Teaching) [1].

Music Industry: MUSI 255; choose 1 200-level culture course (201, 202, 203, 208, 224, 225, 232, 233, 237, 240, 245, 249) and 1 upper-level culture course (302, 305, 309, 325, 328, 330, 335, 336, 343, 345, 352, 355, 365, 390); all COMM 202, DATA 101, MUSI 123 or 140, 263, 301, 313, 316, 350; choose 2 electives (BADM 223, 235; COMM 303; INFO 224; MGMT 205, 302, 303; MKTG 290, 350; MUSI 120, 223, 261, 410, or unnamed catalog entry); CNTP 388; MUSI 450 [1].

Music Performance: MUSI 255; choose 1 200-level culture course (201, 202, 203, 208, 224, 225, 232, 233, 237, 240, 245, 249) and 1 upper-level (302, 305, 309, 313, 325, 328, 330, 335, 336, 343, 345, 352, 355, 365, 390); basics MUSI 123, 209, 210, 300, 400; choose 1 technique (206, 213, 234, 235, 337); 12 group-performance credits (126, 227, 253, 270, 271, 272, 273, 303, 320, 327, 364, 366); choose 1 elective (120, unnamed catalog entry, 251, 263, 332, 360); 2 credits MUSI 130; 2 flexible credits (126, 227, 230, 270, 271, 272, 273, 340, 364, 430); MUSI 450 [1].

Music Production: MUSI 255; choose 1 200-level culture course (201, 202, 203, 208, 224, 225, 232, 233, 237, 240, 245, 249) and 1 upper-level (302, 305, 309, 313, 325, 328, 330, 335, 336, 343, 345, 352, 355, 365, 390); all MUSI 120, 123, 210, 223, 261, 363; choose 2 production courses (COMM 435, unnamed catalog entry, MUSI 323, 328, 362, 366, 415, 424); choose 1 elective (251, 263, 313, 316, 327, 345, 360); CNTP 388; 4 group-performance credits (126, 227, 253, 270, 271, 272, 273, 303, 320, 327, 364, 366); MUSI 450 [1].

Music Studies: all MUSI 123, 210, 255, 316; choose 3 200-level courses (201, 202, 203, 208, 224, 232, 233, 237, 240, 245, 249) and 3 upper-level (305, 309, 313, 325, 330, 335, 336, 343, 345, 352, 355, 365, 390); choose 1 international-focus course (203, 224, 240, 245, 305, 309, 330, 335, 345, 352) and 1 related-discipline course (COMM 204, 208; MUSI 120, 225, 251, 263, 332, 360; THEA 332); 4 performance credits (MUSI 126, 130, 206, 213, 227, 230, 234, 235, 253, 270, 271, 272, 273, 303, 320, 327, 337, 340, 364, 366, 430); choose CNTP 388 or MUSI 400; MUSI 450 [1]. All concentrations also list PATH 001, 002, 003 [1].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-MUSI)

question: Im a freshman in visual arts, what studio classes should I take my first semester vs second semester?
answer:

question: what does music theory 1 cover and does it need a placement test
answer:
MUSI 123 Musicianship I is 4 credits. It covers diatonic harmony—keys, chords, diatonic chord progressions, and Roman Numeral Analysis—and their relationships with melody, rhythm, sound/timbre, arrangement, lyrics, and form. Students study representative classical and popular music through ear training, composition/songwriting, and keyboard performance. Fluency in treble clef, bass clef, and basic rhythms is required. [2]

Yes. All students must first take the Musicianship Placement Test to determine whether to start with Music Fundamentals, Musicianship I, or Musicianship II. The catalog lists MUSI 121 Music Fundamentals or a Musicianship Placement Test score of 075–100 as the prerequisite path for MUSI 123. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/MUSI123)

question: should I double major in music and theater or just minor in one, which is better for getting into grad school
answer:
The pages don’t say whether a double major or a minor is better for graduate-school admission, so I can’t recommend one based on verified information. The catalog does list a Music BA and a Theater Minor [1][2], and says undergraduates may pursue a minor and/or a second major [3]. It lists no bachelor’s major for “music theater” [15]. For two majors, no more than half the courses may count toward both, and you must complete all writing-intensive courses required for the second major [4].

For graduate admission, requirements vary by program; applications are reviewed holistically by the graduate program director. Applicants generally need at least a 3.0 GPA, an official transcript verifying a completed bachelor’s degree, and at least one recommendation letter [5]. The career center suggests exploring graduate programs, attending workshops, writing personal statements, and taking required admission tests [10].

Ask the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) for help weighing the options: success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207.

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-MUSI) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-MN-THEA) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#admissions-criteria1) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/careercenter/four-year-plan/) [15](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: are there any certificates in graphic design or video production I can add on top of my major
answer:
The pages provided don’t verify whether Ramapo offers a graphic-design or video-production certificate. Academic certificates are usually made up of credit-bearing courses; undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral certificates are possible levels. They are not graduation requirements and are removed from the degree audit. [3] Professional Certificates are entirely non-credit and are not noted on transcripts. [2]

To add a certificate, the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) says to complete the [online major/minor declaration form](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/declare-major-minor-certificate/); the Registrar’s Office updates the record in 5–7 days. [7] To add fields, select “Add Another Section.” [6] Contact Academic Advising at success@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7441. [7]

For confirmation of specific certificate offerings, contact the Office of the Provost at provost@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7330. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/declare-major-minor-certificate/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/myadvisor/)
